# Code of conduct

We want Cloudroom to be a welcoming project for everyone.

- Be kind and respectful. Disagree with ideas, not people.
- No harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- No sexual language or imagery, and no discrimination of any kind.
- Don't share other people's private information.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, issues, and pull requests that break these rules, and may block repeat offenders.

Report problems privately to [david@davidondrej.com](mailto:david@davidondrej.com).
